medications.name: Oxycodone
medications.frequency: Every 4-6 hours as needed for severe pain
medications.instructions: Take with food to prevent nausea. Do not drive or operate machinery while taking this medication. Do not consume alcohol.

medications.name: Ibuprofen
medications.instructions: Take scheduled around the clock for the first 5 days to manage inflammation, even if pain is mild. Do not take on an empty stomach.

medications.name: Aspirin
medications.instructions: Prescribed for DVT prophylaxis — do not skip doses. Take with a full glass of water. Continue for 4 weeks post-discharge unless otherwise directed.

restrictions.rule: Weight-bearing as tolerated with crutches. Gradually wean off crutches only as comfort allows.
Keep dressing clean and dry. You may shower after 48 hours but wrap the knee in plastic wrap.
Begin passive knee extension exercises. Do not force flexion past 90 degrees. PT sessions start Day 3.
No driving for a minimum of 2 weeks or while taking Oxycodone, whichever is longer. No return to work until cleared by Dr. Chen.

warning_signs.symptom: Calf pain, sudden swelling, or warmth in the leg
warning_signs.implication: Potential Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) — blood clot in the leg
warning_signs.action: Go to the Emergency Room immediately — do not wait

warning_signs.implication: Potential infection at the surgical site

warning_signs.symptom: Increasing redness, warmth, or discharge at the incision site
warning_signs.action: Call Dr. Chen's office within 24 hours or go to urgent care

warning_signs.symptom: Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain
warning_signs.implication: Possible pulmonary embolism — blood clot in the lung
warning_signs.action: Call 911 or go to the Emergency Room immediately
